# Struct Tags & JSON in Go

Struct tags are metadata strings attached to struct fields. Most commonly used with the `encoding/json` package to control JSON serialization and deserialization.

## Struct Tag Syntax

Struct tags are written as raw string literals (backticks) after the field type:

```go
type User struct {
    ID       int    `json:"id"`
    Username string `json:"username"`
    Password string `json:"-"`            // skip this field
    Age      int    `json:"age,omitempty"` // skip if zero
}
```

## json.Marshal — Struct to JSON

```go
p := Product{ID: 1, Name: "Laptop", Price: 15000000}
data, err := json.Marshal(p)
fmt.Println(string(data))
// {"id":1,"name":"Laptop","price":15000000}

pretty, _ := json.MarshalIndent(p, "", "  ")
fmt.Println(string(pretty))
```

## json.Unmarshal — JSON to Struct

```go
jsonData := `{"id":2,"name":"Mouse","price":250000}`
var product Product
err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(jsonData), &product)
fmt.Println(product.Name)  // Mouse
```

## omitempty and json:"-"

```go
type Response struct {
    Code    int    `json:"code"`
    Message string `json:"message"`
    Error   string `json:"error,omitempty"` // skipped if empty
}
// {"code":200,"message":"OK"} — no error field
```

## API Response Pattern

```go
type APIResponse struct {
    Success bool        `json:"success"`
    Code    int         `json:"code"`
    Data    interface{} `json:"data,omitempty"`
    Error   *APIError   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
```

quiz.question_id: Apa fungsi dari tag `json:"-"` pada field struct?
quiz.question_en: What does the `json:"-"` tag on a struct field do?
options_id: Mengubah nama field menjadi "-" dalam JSON
Membuat field tidak ikut di-serialize/deserialize ke/dari JSON
options_en: Renames the field to "-" in JSON
Excludes the field from JSON serialization/deserialization

quiz.question_id: Apa yang dilakukan tag `json:"name,omitempty"` jika field `name` memiliki nilai `""`?
quiz.question_en: What does the tag `json:"name,omitempty"` do if the `name` field has value `""`?
options_id: Field tetap muncul di JSON dengan nilai ""
Field tidak muncul di JSON output
options_en: The field still appears in JSON with value ""
The field is omitted from the JSON output
The field is replaced with a default value
